period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the First Quarter ended 31 March 2019 (Unaudited)"), downloaded directly from the bank's live financial-statements archive (legacy.citybankplc.com/report/financialstatements), not Wayback Machine. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 31 March 2019' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the first quarter ended 31 March 2019') figures are used, not the explicitly-labelled 'Consolidated' panels. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 310,677,909,239 + Shareholders' equity 24,847,697,912 = Total assets 335,525,607,151 exactly; Net interest income 2,514,374,319 + Investment income 509,652,389 + Commission 788,193,808 + Other operating income 528,772,910 = Total operating income 4,340,993,427 (source document's own subtotal, off by 1 taka from the component sum due to rounding in the original). Income-statement figures are cumulative-from-Jan-1 (identical to a discrete quarter for Q1 specifically). Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). This filing includes an explicit Note 4.a 'Net Assets Value per Share (NAV) - The City Bank Limited' (Solo basis: Shareholders' equity / weighted number of shares, comparing 31-Mar-2019 to 31-Mar-2018), so nav_per_share is reported here (not calculated) -- this is actually the earliest primary interim filing in the recovered series with an explicit NAV note, one quarter earlier than previously noted in 2019_Q2.json.
